outcome_evidence: The oven door is open at frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot gradually approaches and aligns with the door through frames 20–100, then raises it toward the oven through frames 102–124. By frames 128–143, image and left_ego_image show the door upright and closed against the oven front as the gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or harmful side effect is visible.
